question: How should one join the atom for self-yoga in that state?
premises: Then one should scatter the full [substance].
One should lift the atom into the self.
This joining is for the yoga of the self in that state.
It is performed with that other oblation.
inference: The atom is joined into the self for state-yoga by means of the other oblation.
uncertainties: The exact referent of pūrṇāṃ is unclear.
The compound vitīryāṇumutkṣipyātmani has an ambiguous parsing.
The dense compound tātsthyātmasaṃsthyayogāya has an uncertain precise syntactic relation.
plain_english: Then, scattering the full [substance], one should lift the atom into the self and join it for the yoga of the self abiding in that state, with that other oblation.
